variant.subject: Have you seen what’s new, {{name}}?
variant.preheader: There’s something intriguing waiting for you inside InfoGenie.
variant.body: We’ve been busy updating InfoGenie with fresh insights, tools, and resources you might love. Haven’t checked in for a while? Don’t worry—your account’s ready, and there’s a lot to discover when you return. The question is: what will surprise you today?
